strings.name: Sultan Al Jaber
strings.summary: Trained as an engineer, Al Jaber founded and led Masdar before heading ADNOC and becoming the UAE’s industry minister. He chaired COP28 in 2023, helping parties reach agreement on energy transition. His combined oil-expansion and climate-negotiation roles attracted conflict-of-interest criticism. Clean-energy investments and diplomatic commitments must be distinguished from actual emissions reductions.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a real-time news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Held major roles in energy companies and climate negotiations, connecting fossil energy, renewables and policy.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth
strings.facts.f1.value: Born 31 August 1973 in Umm Al Quwain, UAE.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Chemical-engineering bachelor’s, USC; MBA, Cal State Los Angeles; doctorate, Coventry.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Energy businesses
strings.highlights.h1.text: Led ADNOC and participated in Masdar’s development, connecting oil and gas, clean energy and industrial policy.
strings.highlights.h2.title: COP28 negotiations
strings.highlights.h2.text: As president, helped parties agree; outcomes resulted from multilateral negotiations rather than sole personal decisions.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Renewable-project announcement
strings.timeline.t1.text: Presented Masdar’s solar-and-battery project for round-the-clock power; announcement did not mean operation.
strings.timeline.t2.title: COP28 consensus
strings.timeline.t2.text: Parties adopted a stocktake decision calling for a just, orderly and equitable transition away from fossil fuels.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Industry minister
strings.timeline.t3.text: Appointed UAE minister of industry and advanced technology.
strings.timeline.t4.title: ADNOC chief executive
strings.timeline.t4.text: Appointed group chief executive of Abu Dhabi National Oil Company.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Masdar chairman
strings.timeline.t5.text: Moved from founding CEO to chairman.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Minister of state
strings.timeline.t6.text: Joined the UAE federal cabinet as minister of state.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Climate envoy
strings.timeline.t7.text: First served as UAE climate envoy, later reappointed in 2020.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Founded Masdar
strings.timeline.t8.text: Became founding CEO of the renewable-energy platform.
